newsitem.title: JAPAN: TIFFE Euroyen ends up after BOJ governor's comment.
newsitem.headline: TIFFE Euroyen ends up after BOJ governor's comment.

text.p: The key March three-month Euroyen futures contract ended the day session up on Monday, tracking the key December Japanese government bond futures which rose following comments made by the Bank of Japan governor over the weekend.
"Euroyen futures were boosted by a rise in JGB futures and comments by the BOJ's governor," said a brokerage trader.
The March Euroyen futures contract moved within a range of 99.19 to 99.24 during the day session.

"Long-term interest rates have previously reflected expectations of stronger economic prospects but some changes have been seen recently, in accordance with conditions," said BOJ governor Yasuo Matsushita, who was in Washington attending an annual meeting of the World Bank and International Monetary Fund.
The market was reluctant to trade heavily ahead of the release of Japan's August industrial output data, traders said.
